I had a slight problem with my dental implant performed by Dr.Ford at Mr. White Dental Clinic almost a year ago.

Though an urgent queue was assigned, Dr. Ford was kind enough to give me a call  prior to the appointment to ask me in details about the symptoms and whether I had experienced any painful  feelings.

His words of proper responsibility to take care of the problem  reveals his true concern on the patient, making  me feel a lot more relieved and secured.

He even allowed me to come in earlier to examine and fix the  problem.

Fortunately, the problem wasn’t that serious, taking no more than 20 minutes to complete and, of course, without any pain due to his gentle hands.

I was extremely grateful for his kindness in fixing the problem.

I have no hesitation in recommending Dr. Ford at
Mr. White Dental Clinic. He has all the skills and experience necessary to excel in the role.

My mother (Aj. Laa) had a dental implant with Dr. Ford at Mr. White Clinic. The communication and interaction throughout the process were truly professional and responsive. During the procedure, Dr. Ford was extremely patient and, most importantly, performed operation/implant with a light touch with minimal pain. The clinic is also transparent with the pricing and offers installment payment options. I cannot express enough gratitude to Dr. Ford and highly recommend this place for patients seeking dental implant. You will get the whole package here including consultation, procedure, as well as follow-up. My mom also had teeth cleaning here at a reasonable price, which is performed by a Dental hygienist. text: The service is good, but it's a gamble. I've been using their services for 2-3 years, and have had good and bad doctors. Most recently, I encountered a doctor who was terrible; they constantly yelled at the assistant and spoke to me rudely. I don't know what they were so upset about. Since then, I've switched clinics.

1. I came for a filling, but the assistant pressed the suction device very hard on my mouth. It was so hard that it left marks and hurt. When I swallowed, as saliva was flowing down my throat, I was scolded for constantly pushing my tongue against my mouth.
2. The staff at the counter weren't very good. I messaged to book an appointment via LINE in the morning, but no one replied. So I left a message on the Facebook page as well. A staff member replied on the page, and I made an appointment. I informed them that I would be using social security benefits. When I arrived, the staff member scolded me, saying, "Our clinic opens at 9 am. You messaged at 8 am. There might not have been anyone to reply. And please don't message through multiple channels. Don't message repeatedly." If you're not comfortable replying, you don't have to. If you don't want multiple contacts, you should have stated it on the page.
3. I informed them on the page that I would be using social security benefits. When I arrived, the staff asked if I wanted the same medical certificate and receipt as my friend. I said yes. When it came time to pay, the staff asked for a full payment. I told them I wanted to use social security benefits. The counter staff member looked displeased and said, "But we initially asked you if you would be claiming it yourself."

I'll probably only use their service once.
(But the staff member with short hair at the counter provided good service.)
